title: Rotjana — AI Document Agent
desc: Claude-powered Discord agent that lets the IT team read and update QMS documents in plain Thai.
longDesc: Claude-powered Discord agent for the factory's IT knowledge vault — the IT team reads and updates QMS Excel registers in plain Thai through a custom agentic loop with auto-loaded tools. Every write goes through a preview-and-confirm step with column-level permissions, file locking, and automatic backups. It also reads attachments (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, images via Claude vision) and serves NFC tap-to-lookup pages for the hardware asset registry.

title: Enterprise Resource Planning
desc: In-house factory ERP covering BOM, raw materials, purchase orders, and MRP forecasting.
longDesc: In-house ERP replacing fragmented per-department Excel sheets — Bill of Materials, raw material inventory, purchase-order planning, and MRP forecasting with CSV import and auto-matching. Built solo as a modular monolith of 8 modules with enforced public-API boundaries, developed through a custom AI-driven pipeline (plan → design → scaffold → test → docs) and deployed on-premise with Docker + Portainer.

title: Massage Administration System
desc: Web admin system for Thai massage parlors — appointments, staff wages, and revenue reports.
longDesc: Web-based administration system for Thai massage parlors, built as a modular monolith with role-based access for Admin and Secretary. Handles appointment scheduling, staff profiles, and service management — with wage calculation that rounds booked time up to 30-minute intervals plus tip hours, per-duration service pricing, and monthly revenue reports.

title: Crossword Solver
desc: Algorithm that solves a crossword game with 8 interconnected paths using backtracking.
longDesc: Algorithm that calculates the answer to a crossword game with 8 interconnected paths and moves down the grid as letters are used. Uses backtracking to find the correct path.

title: NFC Deck Tracker
desc: Mobile app for managing and tracking TCG decks in real time with NFC.
longDesc: Mobile app for managing and tracking TCG decks in real time with NFC. Built with Flutter under the concept of Clean Architecture as a Bachelor's Thesis at Silpakorn University.

title: Astral Oracle
desc: Web app for tarot card readings with personalized predictions powered by Groq AI.
longDesc: Web app for tarot card readings with personalized predictions powered by Groq AI. It features an interactive interface for drawing and interpreting tarot cards.
